description: CROSS-REPO — owned and built in AGORA, not koine. Delivers KFT §9.1(c): the finetune KCB client that replaces the stub runner — discover -> invoke -> SUBSCRIBE to the §6 telemetry stream, wiring export (§5.3) + registry (§8) + invoke:finetune grants (§7). Per ADR-0001 the runtime lives downstream; koine holds only the KFT contract it implements. Tracked here as a koine ROADMAP Phase F3 marker ('agora chief/59-finetune-kcb-client'). Its live end-to-end run is blocked until chief/57 (agora general provider) OR chief/58 (lugh specialist) ships a real provider (ROADMAP.md F3 depends-on). PARKED in koine: placeholder; move to agora/tasks/chief/ to activate.
warmup: echo 'Cross-repo: implement in agora against koine specs/fine-tuning.md §6/§5.3/§8/§7 and §9.1(c)'

acceptanceCriteria: Implemented in agora (not koine): discover the finetune capability, invoke it, and SUBSCRIBE to the §6 training-telemetry stream, wiring export (§5.3), registry routing (§8), and invoke:finetune grants (§7) per fine-tuning.md §9.1(c) — replacing the stub runner.

Conforms to koine's KFT contract by reference; the live end-to-end run is gated on a real provider from chief/57 or chief/58 (F3 depends-on), and the client tolerates a checkpoint ref arriving before its bytes (KCB delta L, KFT §6).
Runs under agora's own gates; no koine file is edited by this tasklist.
userStories.notes: Cross-repo (agora). Parked in koine as a ROADMAP F3 marker.
